references.text: The Israelites cried out to the Lord when Pharaoh and the Egyptians approached them at the Red Sea.
The pillar of cloud moved between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of the Israelites, bringing darkness for the Egyptians.
The sea returned and covered the chariots and horsemen of the Egyptians who had pursued the Israelites.
Israel saw the great work that the Lord did against the Egyptians.
The Israelites wandered in the wilderness for forty years as a result of their disobedience.
Moses reminds the people of what their eyes saw in Egypt, the great signs and wonders.
The psalm describes how God performed miraculous deeds in Egypt and parted the sea for his people.
The psalm tells about the fathers at the Red Sea and how God saved them from their enemy and covered their opponents with water.
Hebrews mentions crossing the Red Sea by faith, where the Egyptians drowned when they tried to do the same.
